articles.title_en: When Climate Change Determines International Agreements: Evidence from Water Treaties
articles.title_cn: 当气候变化决定国际协议：来自水资源条约的证据
articles.abstract_en: Is climate change pushing governments to implement international treaties for the management of common resources? Yes, at least with respect to the Water Treaties (WTs) on common basins and rivers studied in this article. We found that climatic conditions, such as higher temperatures and lower precipitation, directly lead to a higher likelihood of signing WTs in the short, and even more so in the long run. By analyzing the impact of changes in climatic conditions observed between 1961–1975 and 1993–2007, we found that a one-degree Celsius increase in temperature has resulted in a 16.6% increase in the likelihood of signing WTs. These results are obtained for treaties related to environmental protection and economic development, and they also hold for “strong” treaties.
articles.abstract_cn: 气候变化是否正在推动各国政府实施关于共同资源管理的国际条约？是的，至少就本文研究的关于共同流域和河流的水资源条约（WTs）而言是如此。我们发现，气候条件，例如更高的气温和更少的降水，会直接导致签署WTs的可能性更高，在短期内如此，在长期内更是如此。通过分析在1961-1975和1993-2007之间观察到的气候条件变化的影响，我们发现气温每升高一摄氏度，签署WTs的可能性就增加了16.6%。这些结果适用于与环境保护和经济发展相关的条约，并且也适用于“强”条约。

articles.title_en: Green Innovation and Economic Growth in a North–South Model
articles.title_cn: 南北模型中的绿色创新与经济增长
articles.abstract_en: If one region of the world switches its research effort from dirty to clean technologies, will other regions follow? To investigate this question, this paper builds a North–South model that combines insights from directed technological change and quality-ladder endogenous growth models with business-stealing innovations. While North represents the region with climate ambitions, both regions have researchers choosing between clean and dirty applications, and the resulting technologies are traded. Three main results emerge: (1) In the long run, if the North’s research and development (R&D) sector is sufficiently large, researchers in South will follow the switch from dirty to clean R&D made by researchers in North, motivated by the growing value of clean markets. (2) If the two regions direct research effort toward different sectors and the outputs of the two sectors are gross substitutes, then the long-run growth rates in both regions will be lower than if the global research effort were invested in one sector. (3) If the North’s government induces its researchers to switch to clean R&D through clean technology subsidies, the welfare-maximising choice for South is to ensure that all of its researchers switch too, unless the social discount rate is high. The last result is true even if the South’s R&D sector is large.
articles.abstract_cn: 如果世界上的一个地区将其研究努力从肮脏技术转向清洁技术，其他地区会跟随吗？为了研究这个问题，本文构建了一个南北模型，该模型结合了定向技术变迁和质量阶梯内生增长模型与商业窃取创新的洞见。虽然北方代表具有气候雄心的地区，但两个地区都有研究人员在清洁和肮脏应用之间进行选择，并且由此产生的技术被交易。出现了三个主要结果：(1) 在长期中，如果北方的研究与开发（R&D）部门足够大，南方的研究人员将跟随北方研究人员从肮脏R&D转向清洁R&D的转变，其动机是清洁市场价值的增长。(2) 如果两个地区将研究努力导向不同部门，并且两个部门的产出是总替代品，那么两个地区的长期增长率将低于全球研究努力投资于一个部门时的增长率。(3) 如果北方政府通过清洁技术补贴诱导其研究人员转向清洁R&D，那么南方福利最大化的选择是确保其所有研究人员也转向，除非社会贴现率高。即使南方的R&D部门很大，最后一个结果也成立。

articles.title_en: Drought Exposure and Accuracy: Motivated Reasoning in Climate Change Beliefs
articles.title_cn: 干旱暴露与准确性：气候变化信念中的动机性推理
articles.abstract_en: The lack of stringent policies to avert climate change has increased the importance of effective and timely adaptation. Adequate adaptation is particularly important for agricultural communities in developing countries, which may most suffer the consequences of climate change. Evidence is still scarce on how people in the most vulnerable areas form climate change beliefs and whether such beliefs exhibit cognitive biases. Using survey data from rural households in Bangladesh together with a meteorological measure of excess dryness relative to historical averages, I study the effect of long-term average drought exposure and short-term deviations on beliefs about drought frequency and the interpretation of drought events. To explore how individuals interpret past droughts, I use an instrumental variable approach and investigate whether individual beliefs lead to asymmetric distortion of objective information. The results show that individuals recollect and overweight evidence tilted towards their prior beliefs, providing evidence of confirmation bias as a directional motivated reasoning mechanism. The findings highlight the need for models that account for behavioral factors and cognitive biases in the study of climate change beliefs for effective communication and adaptation policies.
articles.abstract_cn: 缺乏遏制气候变化的严格政策，增加了有效且及时适应的重要性。充分的适应对发展中国家的农业社区尤为重要，这些社区可能受气候变化后果的影响最为严重。关于最脆弱地区的人们如何形成气候变化信念，以及这些信念是否表现出认知偏差，证据仍然稀缺。利用孟加拉国农村家庭的调查数据，结合相对于历史平均值的过度干燥的气象测量，我研究了长期平均干旱暴露和短期偏离对干旱频率信念及对干旱事件解释的影响。为了探究个体如何解释过去的干旱，我使用工具变量方法，并考察个体信念是否导致对客观信息的不对称扭曲。结果表明，个体回忆并过度加权倾向于其先前信念的证据，提供了确认偏差作为方向性动机性推理机制的证据。这些发现凸显了在气候变化信念研究中纳入行为因素和认知偏差的模型的必要性，以实现有效的沟通和适应政策。

articles.title_en: Eliciting Non-hypothetical Willingness-to-pay for Novel Products: An Application to Cultured Meat
articles.title_cn: 诱导对新型产品的非假设性支付意愿：一项对培养肉的应用
articles.abstract_en: Estimating the demand for greener products may be challenging when these products are not yet on the market. We design an experiment to elicit the willingness-to-pay (WTP) for a novel product in a non-hypothetical way, despite the fact that the product is not marketed and thus cannot be delivered to participants. We consider a cultured meat product which is presented to participants using the producer’s advertising. The basic experimental device consists in eliciting (i) how much a participant is willing to pay for the product under uncertainty about product delivery, and (ii) her beliefs about the probability that the product will be actually delivered. In our sample of 158 French students, under 20% of participants never want to buy the product, and below 10% assign a probability of zero that the product will be delivered if purchased. The average WTP is fairly low, at about 3 Euros per 100 g. A number of factors increase (e.g., education and low meat consumption) or decrease (e.g., neophobia and disgust) this WTP. The simple exposure to the new meat substitute during this experiment reduces subjects’ pro-meat justifications. We investigate the external validity of our results using a hypothetical survey on a representative sample (N = 1200). We also discuss methodological issues such as deception and incentive compatibility.
articles.abstract_cn: 当更环保的产品尚未上市时，估计其需求可能具有挑战性。我们设计了一项实验，以非假设性的方式诱导对一种新型产品的支付意愿（WTP），尽管该产品尚未上市，因此无法交付给参与者。我们考虑了一种培养肉产品，并使用生产商的广告向参与者展示。基本的实验装置包括诱导（i）参与者在产品交付不确定的情况下愿意为该产品支付多少，以及（ii）她对产品实际交付概率的信念。在我们的158名法国学生样本中，不到20%的参与者从不想购买该产品，不到10%的参与者认为如果购买，产品交付的概率为零。平均WTP相当低，约为每100 g 3欧元。一些因素会增加（例如，教育和低肉类消费）或减少（例如，新事物恐惧和厌恶）这种WTP。在这个实验中，仅仅接触这种新的肉类替代品就减少了受试者支持肉类的理由。我们使用一项对代表性样本（N = 1200）的假设性调查来研究我们结果的外部有效性。我们还讨论了诸如欺骗和激励相容性等方法论问题。

articles.title_en: Anatomy of Green Specialisation: Evidence from EU Production Data, 1995–2015
articles.title_cn: 绿色专业化的解剖：来自欧盟生产数据的证据，1995-2015
articles.abstract_en: We study green specialisation across EU countries and detailed 4-digit industrial sectors over the period of 1995–2015 by harmonizing product-level data (PRODCOM). We propose a new list of green goods that refines lists proposed by international organizations by excluding goods with double usage. Our analysis reveals important structural characteristics of green specialisation in the manufacturing sector. First, green production is highly concentrated, with 13 out of 119 4-digit industries, which are high-tech and account for nearly 95% of the total. Second, green and polluting productions do not occur in the same sectors, and countries specialise in either green or brown sectors. Third, our econometric analysis identifies three key features as relevant for green specialisation: (i) first-mover advantage and high persistence of green specialisation, (ii) complementarity with non-green capabilities and (iii) the degree of diversification of green capabilities.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过统一产品级数据（PRODCOM），研究了1995-2015年期间欧盟各国及详细的4位数工业部门的绿色专业化。我们提出了一个新的绿色商品清单，该清单通过排除双重用途的商品，对国际组织提出的清单进行了细化。我们的分析揭示了制造业中绿色专业化的重要结构特征。首先，绿色生产高度集中，在119个4位数工业中，有13个是高科技行业，占总量的近95%。其次，绿色生产和污染生产不会出现在同一部门，各国要么专精于绿色部门，要么专精于棕色部门。第三，我们的计量经济学分析确定了与绿色专业化相关的三个关键特征：（i）先发优势和绿色专业化的高持续性，（ii）与非绿色能力的互补性，以及（iii）绿色能力的多样化程度。

articles.title_en: The Impacts of Removing Fossil Fuel Subsidies and Increasing Carbon Taxation in Ireland
articles.title_cn: 爱尔兰取消化石燃料补贴与提高碳税的影响
articles.abstract_en: Though the magnitude of fossil fuel subsidies eclipses carbon pricing revenues, policies and economic literature focus on carbon taxation. This paper aims to show that removing fossil fuel subsidies can reduce emissions as much as carbon taxation without making producers and consumers worse off. Using a dynamic intertemporal CGE model of Ireland, we compare removing eight Irish fossil fuel subsidies and increasing the carbon tax to €100 per tonne by 2030. We find that both policies result in similar emission reductions. Carbon taxation results in lower negative GDP and investment impacts, whereas subsidy removal results in lower negative employment impacts, higher revenues, an improved trade balance and lower debt. The impacts across sectors and households are distributed more evenly under a carbon tax, where subsidy removal results in extreme impacts for specific sectors and households. Excluding households’ subsidies from removal can alleviate these household distributional impacts at no cost to emission reduction. With revenue recycling reducing tax rates, a double-dividend is found at the expense of worsened income distribution. The economic benefit of revenue recycling is greater when removing subsidies than with carbon taxation and results confirm the importance of fossil fuel subsidies in climate policy.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管化石燃料补贴的规模超过了碳定价收入，但政策和经济文献侧重于碳税。本文旨在表明，取消化石燃料补贴可以在不使生产者和消费者状况恶化的情况下，实现与碳税同等的减排效果。利用爱尔兰的动态跨期CGE模型，我们比较了取消八项爱尔兰化石燃料补贴与到2030年将碳税提高至每吨€100的影响。我们发现，两种政策都能带来相似的减排效果。碳税导致的GDP和投资负面影响较小，而取消补贴则导致就业负面影响较小、收入更高、贸易平衡改善和债务降低。在碳税下，各部门和家庭之间的影响分布更为均匀，而取消补贴则对特定部门和家庭产生极端影响。将家庭补贴排除在取消范围之外，可以在不牺牲减排效果的情况下缓解这些家庭分配影响。通过收入循环降低税率，发现了双重红利，但以收入分配恶化为代价。取消补贴时收入循环的经济效益大于碳税，结果证实了化石燃料补贴在气候政策中的重要性。

articles.title_en: Drivers of Bilateral Climate Finance Aid: The Roles of Paris Agreement Commitments, Public Governance, and Multilateral Institutions
articles.title_cn: 双边气候融资援助的驱动因素：《巴黎协定》承诺、公共治理和多边机构的作用
articles.abstract_en: Using granular data from the OECD from 2010 to 2018 that differentiate between adaptation and mitigation measures to address climate change, we employed a double-hurdle model to examine whether countries’ Paris Agreement commitments and governance capacity help attract international climate-change-related financial aid. We found that (1) countries received a short-term aid boost in the year when they submitted the nationally determined contribution, and countries that committed only to action targets rather than emission goals were more likely to receive funds; (2) both the quality of the budget and financial management and the quality of public administration significantly enhanced the likelihood of receiving aid, but only the quality of public administration contributed to attracting funding for adaptations; and (3) multilateral institutions played catalytic roles in fostering bilateral international climate-change aid, particularly by increasing the likelihood of funding.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用经合组织2010年至2018年区分气候变化适应和减缓措施的微观数据，我们采用双障碍模型考察了各国的《巴黎协定》承诺和治理能力是否有助于吸引国际气候变化相关财政援助。我们发现：（1）各国在提交国家自主贡献的当年获得了短期援助提振，且仅承诺行动目标而非排放目标的国家更有可能获得资金；（2）预算和财务管理质量以及公共行政质量均显著提高了获得援助的可能性，但只有公共行政质量有助于吸引适应资金；（3）多边机构在促进双边国际气候变化援助方面发挥了催化作用，特别是提高了获得资金的可能性。

articles.title_en: Valuing Ecosystem Services and Downstream Water Quality Improvement in the U.S. Corn Belt
articles.title_cn: 评估美国玉米带生态系统服务与下游水质改善
articles.abstract_en: We develop a choice experiment (CE) to estimate the benefits of nutrient reductions in the US Corn Belt. The study area covers Illinois, Indiana, and Iowa, the three states that contribute the largest amount of nutrients to the Gulf of Mexico and whose nutrient reductions are vital to achieving targets to reduce the hypoxic dead zone in the Gulf. We find that the public places large values on various local ecosystem services, including aquatic biodiversity, aesthetics of increased farm landscape diversity associated with conservation practices, and water-based recreational activities. Moreover, the results indicate that upstream residents have a strong preference for water quality far downstream in the Gulf of Mexico as characterized by reducing the size of the dead zone. Our analysis of observed taste heterogeneity indicates that public preferences vary depending on familiarity with nutrient pollution issues, users versus non-users of local ecosystem services, and different age groups. Our findings inform policies to improve water quality in the Gulf of Mexico and local water bodies in the US Corn Belt.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一项选择实验（CE），以估算美国玉米带养分削减的效益。研究区域覆盖伊利诺伊州、印第安纳州和爱荷华州，这三个州向墨西哥湾贡献的养分量最大，其养分削减对于实现减少墨西哥湾缺氧死区的目标至关重要。我们发现，公众对多种本地生态系统服务赋予较大价值，包括水生生物多样性、与保护实践相关的农田景观多样性增加的美学价值，以及水上休闲活动。此外，结果表明，上游居民对墨西哥湾远下游的水质有强烈偏好，其特征是减少死区面积。我们对观察到的偏好异质性分析表明，公众偏好因对养分污染问题的熟悉程度、本地生态系统服务的使用者与非使用者以及不同年龄组而异。我们的发现为改善墨西哥湾和美国玉米带当地水体的水质政策提供了信息。
